rationale: The Analyst's observed curves describe non-monotone, sign-changing coordinate contrasts: landmark_00_soft_mass rises early then falls late (H001), landmark_00_local_dy shows a transient early negative excursion that decays (H002), and landmark_00_local_cxy oscillates with near-zero whole-window mean (H003). None of these specifies a signed, sustained coordinate direction over the observed support [0.0,0.49], and all continuous_trends rows report polynomial_accepted=false and extrapolation_allowed=false. The registered dose recipes (W1/W2/W3) are time-order interventions on the ratio budget that presuppose a defensible early-vs-late emphasis; the evidence here is transient and oscillatory rather than a monotone early/late contrast, so no offered recipe is justified. Decoded affinity labels are unobserved (equal score prior), so no measured benefit supports a change. Retaining the tested incumbent is the warranted action; a dose study can be reconsidered if a stable, signed temporal profile is independently established.
